facts.business: Healthy Life Agritec Limited manufactures, imports, exports, wholesales, and retails agri-inputs such as fertilizers, micronutrients, pesticides, veterinary and livestock feeds, fish feeds, agricultural implements, and also engages in poultry, agricultural farming, fish rearing, dairy farming, and processing of food products including milk, meat, and packaged foods.

capacity_or_capex.item: State-of-the-art, fully integrated, automated manufacturing facility

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The auditor noted non-compliance with TDS provisions, lack of provisions for late payment charges and interest, inventory/debtors/creditors/security deposits/intangible assets valuation certified by management, unavailability of Internal Audit Report and report on internal financial controls, non-compliance with Employees Provident Fund and Employee's State Insurance provisions, and outstanding undisputed income tax liabilities.

key_risks: Climate change and scarcity of water affecting dairy industry
Drought or rainfall deficit increasing cattle feed cost and reducing green fodder availability
Non-compliance with TDS, EPF, ESI provisions
